newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASIAN DOLLAR DEPOSITS QUIETLY STEADY IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ASIAN DOLLAR DEPOSITS QUIETLY STEADY IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in moderate trade on Friday with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some light activity at the short end. There's no fresh news or (U.S.) economic news coming out tonight and most people were sidelined," a local dealer said.
"Range trade dominated activity today as most people are squaring or are squaring their positions ahead of the weekend," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend, Monday/Tuesday and week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Thursday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
